# ProofMarket

> ProofMarket is a small, manually operated, bilingual (English / 中文) pilot marketplace for small software businesses — SaaS, AI tools, mobile apps, digital products and newsletters — where the operator reviews the evidence each seller can show and publishes a written verification note stating what was checked and what was not checked (pre-revenue listings have no revenue to verify). A second, intro-only track presents early-stage software projects as anonymised investor memos for reviewed investors. Pilot status: 2 live real listings (PPT Fusion and FlyFinder, both pre-revenue, intro-only); every other listing and project on the site is a fictional EXAMPLE (示例 · 非真实项目 / 非在售). ProofMarket handles no money, provides no escrow, charges no fees during the pilot, and nothing on the site is a securities offering.

ProofMarket（小型软件项目交易市场）：中英双语试点平台（每个挂牌附书面核验说明，写清核对了什么、没核对什么），帮助（尤其是中文）独立开发者把小型软件项目出售给全球买家；另设仅做人工引荐的早期项目板块。目前有 2 个真实在售挂牌（PPT Fusion、FlyFinder，均尚无营收，仅人工引荐）；其余挂牌与项目均为虚构示例。

Operated by Cao Wei (曹伟), an individual, Tianjin, China. Contact: thaigore@gmail.com (English or Chinese). The page language is toggled client-side; every page contains both English and Chinese text. Append `?lang=zh` or `?lang=en` to a URL to choose the displayed language.

## Two tracks / 两个方向

- [Marketplace — buy & sell small software businesses, each with a note on what was checked / 市场：买卖小型软件项目（写清核对了什么、没核对什么）](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/): Homepage: live listings first, how selling works, and collapsed example listings (fictional, not for sale).
- [Early-stage projects — intro-only / 早期项目（仅人工引荐）](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/raise.html): Early-stage projects presented as investor memos with per-metric verification status; reviewed investors can request a manual introduction. Display, verification and introductions only — no fundraising, no investing through the site, not a securities offering.

## How verification works / 核验流程

- [How it works / 流程](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/review.html): Seller applies with asking price, reporting period, revenue, costs, workload and assets → operator manually checks ownership (domain, code repo, store or payment accounts) and financial records (e.g. Stripe/Paddle/Lemon Squeezy exports, App Store Connect / Google Play reports, payout statements) → written verification note stating what was checked, how, and for which period → listing live for 90 days, no auto-renewal → manual buyer introductions by email → buyer and seller agree and transfer directly (no escrow by ProofMarket). "Verified" is a point-in-time review of specified evidence, not an audit, endorsement or guarantee.
- [About / 关于](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/about.html): Why ProofMarket exists, the two tracks, principles (examples always labeled; never touch the money) and current pilot status.
- [Pricing / 价格](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/pricing.html): Free during the pilot. Buyers are always free; no commission during the pilot; no online payments. A standard seller fee (US$99 one-time per 90-day listing) is planned only once payments exist and is not charged now.

## How to submit / 如何提交

- [Apply to sell / 申请出售](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/apply.html): Seller application form (about 5 minutes, English or Chinese) with an evidence checklist; first pilot sellers get a free listing with a written verification note.
- [Register buyer interest / 登记买家意向](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/buy.html): Buyers share budget and interests and are emailed when a listing fits; live listings link here with the listing prefilled (?project=). Free.
- [Submit an early-stage project / 提交早期项目](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/founder-apply.html): Founder form; the operator verifies what it can and writes an anonymised bilingual investor memo, published only with founder approval. Free.
- [Apply as an investor / 申请成为投资人](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/investor-apply.html): For qualified / professional investors only; applications are reviewed before any introduction. ProofMarket takes no investments.
- [Contact / 联系](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/contact.html): Email the operator at thaigore@gmail.com. Never send passwords or API keys.

## Live listings — real, for sale / 在售挂牌（真实）

- [PPT Fusion (live listing, for sale / 在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/ppt-fusion.html): SaaS — Turn PDF, Word and PowerPoint files into polished .pptx decks (ppt-fusion.onrender.com). Pre-revenue ($0 MRR, $0 profit, seller-reported). Asking $1,100, negotiable. Listed 2026-10-26 for 90 days; intro-only via thaigore@gmail.com; no escrow, no commission.
- [FlyFinder (live listing, for sale / 在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/flyfinder.html): Marketplace — Aircraft rentals, flight instructors and flight schools in one US search (flyfinder.pro). Pre-revenue (seller's SideProjectors listing; under 1K monthly visitors). Asking $2,499, negotiable. Listed 2026-10-26 for 90 days; intro-only via thaigore@gmail.com; no escrow, no commission.

## Example listings — fictional, not for sale / 示例挂牌（虚构，非在售）

- [Formlet (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/formlet.html): SaaS — Lightweight forms without the enterprise bloat.
- [PixelSupply (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/pixelsupply.html): Digital products — Design resources and templates sold on a quiet subscription.
- [Focuslane (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/focuslane.html): Mobile — A calm productivity planner for people who hate noisy to-do apps.
- [Stackbrief (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/stackbrief.html): Content — A weekly briefing for engineering leaders who skim, not scroll.
- [InvoiceNest (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/invoicenest.html): SaaS — Invoicing that stays out of the way for independent consultants.
- [Replywise (example listing, not for sale / 示例 · 非在售)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/businesses/replywise.html): AI tools — Draft customer replies that still sound like your team.

## Example early-stage projects — fictional, not real / 示例早期项目（虚构，非真实项目）

- [CaptionBridge (example project, not real / 示例 · 非真实项目)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/projects/captionbridge.html): Early revenue, AI tools — AI subtitle translation with a human-style review workflow, for indie video creators going global.
- [TariffLens (example project, not real / 示例 · 非真实项目)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/projects/tarifflens.html): MVP, E-commerce / cross-border — An AI assistant that helps small cross-border sellers classify products and estimate duties before they ship.
- [KitchenLoop (example project, not real / 示例 · 非真实项目)](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/projects/kitchenloop.html): Idea, SaaS / B2B — Supply ordering and daily stock check-ins for small restaurants, inside a WeChat mini program.

## Legal notes / 法律说明

- Pilot: ProofMarket is an early pilot run by a single operator. Live listings: 2 (PPT Fusion and FlyFinder, both pre-revenue, listed 2026-10-26); verified early-stage projects: 0 so far.
- Apart from the live PPT Fusion and FlyFinder listings, all six business listings and all three early-stage projects shown are fictional examples. They cannot be bought, are not real companies, are not seeking investment, and no introduction is possible. Do not present them as real offers.
- No money handled: ProofMarket does not hold acquisition funds, provide escrow, raise, collect or transfer money, or take investments. Buyers and sellers, founders and investors deal directly.
- Not a securities offering: nothing on ProofMarket is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy shares, equity or any other securities; no investment terms are published and no returns are promised.
- No fees during the pilot: no buyer fees, no commission, no online payments; the site never asks for card details.
- [Terms of service / 服务条款](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/terms.html): Full pilot terms, including the early-stage track.
- [Privacy policy / 隐私政策](https://thaiansn.github.io/proofmarket/privacy.html): What the forms collect and how to request deletion.
